mapper.insert: insert into proj_alert_log(rule_id, triggered_at, alert_content, is_read, del_flag, create_time) values (#{ruleId}, now(), #{content}, '0', '0', now())
mapper.select: select count(1) from proj_alert_log where alert_content = #{content} and is_read = '0' and del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from proj_alert_log where is_read = '0' and del_flag = '0'
select id, alert_content as "alertContent", triggered_at as "triggeredAt", is_read as "isRead" from proj_alert_log where is_read = '0' and del_flag = '0' order by triggered_at desc limit #{limit}
